messages:
Maria: Quick review please — updated request drilldown mock: moved timeline to right rail, collapsed stacktrace by default, and moved export to kebab menu. Also proposing a compact Correlation ID row with copy & permalink. Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/drilldown-proto :eyes: Li: Really like the compact row. Two visual nits: 1) the Correlation ID needs clearer affordance for copying (current icon reads small), 2) the stacktrace chevron density feels tight at 12px — can we increase to 16px for hit target? Dylan: Feels doable. Copy icon size + hit area increase is just CSS. Export move is trickier if we want immediate client-side CSV for long traces — might need server-side streaming or a queued job. Sam: A11y notes: copy button needs aria-label that includes the id, eg aria-label="Copy correlation ID 0a1b2c" and a polite live region announcing success. Also kebab menu needs descriptive label for screen readers (not just "More"). Alex: Re: export — large traces can be huge. If we put export behind kebab, show: "Export started — we'll email a link when ready" and disable duplicate requests. Server queue makes sense. We should also show estimated size. Li: On copy affordance: what about inline text + a separate "Copy" link instead of tiny icon? visually: [0a1b2c] Copy | Permalink. Helps discoverability. Dylan: Agree with inline text + Copy link. Implementation note: prefer button element over anchor for clipboard action, and keep role=button semantics. Example HTML we can use: ```html
``` Maria: Copy suggestions make sense. For copy success toast, keep it short: "Copied correlation ID" and include a link to open trace in new tab? maybe overkill. Sam: Toasts need to be dismissible and reachable by keyboard. Live region + toast is fine; ensure focus is not stolen. Alex: For export flow UX: backend returns job id; UI polls job status and enables a download button, plus sends email on completion. Copy the job id into logs for support. Dylan: Will stub endpoints: POST /api/export/trace -> { jobId } and GET /api/export/trace/{jobId}/status. Client shows spinner + "Export queued" then "Download ready". Li: Copy of proposed microcopy: Copy button -> "Copy ID" (aria: "Copy correlation ID {id}"), Permalink -> "Open trace in new tab", Export -> "Export full trace (may take a few minutes)". Thoughts? Maria: I like that wording. Two small asks: 1) shorten "Export full trace (may take a few minutes)" to "Export full trace — we’ll email when ready" for the menu line, 2) make permalink open in new tab with target=_blank and rel=noopener. Sam: +1 on rel=noopener. Also recommend menu items get accessible names: e.g., "Export full trace — opens modal to start job" for screen readers. Dylan: I'll implement the button semantics, aria labels, and wire the job endpoints. Alex, can infra add the export queue and email hook? Alex: Yep, will add a simple queue consumer and S3 presigned URL on completion. ETA: 3 days. Maria: Thanks. Li, Sam — can you both sign off on microcopy and a11y tweaks? I’ll update figma and attach a tiny prototype. Li: Signing off on copy and spacing changes. :thumbsup: Sam: Signing off on a11y changes. Please include the aria-live example in the PR. ux-bot: Checklist: [x] Figma prototype linked, [ ] Accessibility examples attached, [ ] API contract documented. Maria: I'll push the PR with the aria-live snippet and API contract tomorrow morning. Thanks all! :sparkles:
